title: Nightly test of the setups
items: Every night the app replays its own setups on the top 30 Gate markets and records what happened.
Simulator now starts with 'Last night's backtest': how often confirmed and unconfirmed setups reached target 1, with a range for luck.
Under a setup, the chart reading shows how often similar past setups reached target 1 (only once there are at least 100 of them).
Signals and stop/target levels have not changed.

title: Extra confirmation before a setup
items: Every long or short setup now shows 5 extra checks: 4H and 1D trend agree, no delisting, enough trading and a normal 24-hour range. 'Confirmed' means all pass.
Setups now lists only confirmed setups. You can switch this off in Settings.
New strip on each chart: the reading on 15m, 1H, 4H and 1D side by side. Tap one to open it.
Delisting tab now also shows announced delistings from Bybit and the news, including spot delistings like EPIC's on Binance.

title: Delisting list
items: New Delisting tab on Markets: coins Binance, Gate or Bybit plan to delist, with the exchange and the date, soonest first.
Those coins get a red Delisting tag, and their chart screen shows the date at the top.
Exchanges usually close open positions at the delisting time, so it's worth checking before holding one.

title: Clearer wording and legal pages
items: 'Enter long' is now 'Long setup', 'Enter short' is 'Short setup', 'Hold' is 'Wait' and 'Avoid' is 'No setup'. Same rules, clearer wording.
'Confidence' is now 'Agreement' (same number), and 'Size this trade' is now the 'Position size calculator'.
New Terms of Use, Risk Disclosure and Privacy Notice pages (drafts for your lawyer), linked from Help, Settings and a short 'Before you start' screen shown once.
Signals and stop/target levels have not changed.

title: Pull to refresh
items: At the top of any page, pull down and let go to refresh prices.
On the News page it refreshes the headlines too.
The refresh button at the top still works the same way.

title: Stress and safety check
items: The app was tested with about 3,000 markets, a flood of live prices and deliberately broken or harmful data. No way to run harmful code was found.
Fixed: one bad market from an exchange could hide that whole exchange. Now only the bad market is skipped.
Fixed: one odd headline or a broken saved setting could break a page. Both are now cleaned up automatically.
Signals and stop/target levels have not changed.

title: Plan around big news
items: Setups now shows a quiet "Big news later today" line with the times of big releases still to come today, so you can plan before the 30-minute warning.
New switch in Settings: also count big Japan, China and euro-area news, like Bank of Japan or ECB rate decisions. Off by default.
Signals and stop/target levels have not changed.

title: Bottom bar hides while you scroll
items: The bottom bar slides away while you scroll and comes back when you stop.
Don't like it? Settings has a switch to keep the bar on screen.
On/off settings are now slider switches.

title: New Settings page
items: Settings (the sliders button at the top right) is now a full page with your theme, row style, candle size, account size, risk %, max loss and the big news warning in one place.
Changes save as you type, on this device only.
Signals and stop/target levels have not changed.

title: Safety nets
items: If one page breaks, it now shows "hit a snag" with a Try again button, and the rest of the app keeps working.
Problems are saved in Settings → App health. Tap Copy details and send them to Claude.
The app is checked automatically on every update and once every morning; you get an email only if something is wrong.

title: Big news warning
items: When a big US release like CPI, jobs or a Fed decision is within 30 minutes, an amber note shows on the signal card and the Setups page.
It tells you the time, how many minutes away it is, and when it's usually calmer to trade again.
Prices often spike both ways around these releases and stops can fill worse than planned.
Signals and stop/target levels have not changed.

title: Bybit replaces Coinbase
items: Markets, prices and charts now come from Binance, Gate and Bybit.
Bybit's busiest markets and your starred ones update live every second.
4H charts on Bybit use real 4-hour candles.

title: Max-loss guard
items: New in Settings: Max loss per trade (USDT). A good start is about twice your average losing trade.
Size this trade now warns in red when a plan would lose more than that at the stop.
It also shows the smaller size and leverage that keep the loss within your limit.
Signals and stop/target levels have not changed.

title: Nightly improvements switched on
items: Claude now works on the app each night between 1am and 4am and lists what changed here.
Every update has to pass automatic tests before it goes live.
A dot on the ? button means there's something new.

title: News, bottom bar and a cleaner layout
items: News page with headlines, Fear & Greed and upcoming economic events.
Bottom tab bar, compact rows and a 24-hour mini chart on every row.
Light/dark switch in Settings; swipe back from a chart.

title: Simulator
items: Test the app's signals on the last 1,000 candles, including a top-25 stress test.
